workflow.title: Morning digest of all unresolved alerts to #oncall with critical-unacknowledged escalation
workflow.goal: Each morning, post a digest of all unresolved alerts (with severity and service) to the #oncall channel. If any critical alert is still unacknowledged after one hour, email jordan@corestackit.com directly.

assumptions: The 8:00 morning schedule is provided by the external runner that starts this flow once per day with input.now.
The Slack stand-in channel for the digest is #oncall.
An alert is unresolved when resolved is false.
Critical alert age is measured from its at timestamp to input.now in whole hours.
risks: chat.post and outbox.send ask a person before each live dispatch.
Alerts with missing or malformed at values will fail the age step.
The escalation email is sent only when at least one overdue critical alert exists; with none, no email is sent by design.
successCriteria: A digest of all unresolved alerts is posted to #oncall and its hash is verified by chat.audit.
Every unresolved critical alert unacknowledged for at least 1 hour is listed in the escalation email to jordan@corestackit.com, and the email is delivered and verified.
No email is sent when no such alert exists.

nodes.description: Keep alerts that are not resolved.
